name: themes
description: Theme matrix (light → dark → contrast → light) through the real theme button, each followed by a forced rebuild (grip double-click) and scroll re-anchors. Dark is color-only; contrast is a GEOMETRY dimension (2px borders on clauses/reqs/admonitions change document heights). Frames captured between a theme switch and its rebuild are intentionally build-stale (the mock-up has no theme-rebuild path) — mapping asserts skip them via the docHeight coherence guard.
